This replaces it with a lawful, gated engine and gets `pnpm check` green. ## What - **`lib/outreach-compliance.mjs`** — single guardrail core: env-only key (no hardcoded fallback), dry-run default, live-send hard-gated behind `ESTEBAN_SEND_LIVE=1` + `RESEND_API_KEY` + `ESTEBAN_POSTAL_ADDRESS`, suppression list (fail-closed), fabricated-recipient rejection, CAN-SPA
